title: Salt Devil Cruises
specs: Luxury 30 foot Tritoon built in 2021 with premium sound system and sun deck
Sightseeing includes Lydia Ann Lighthouse, dolphin and bird watching
Minimum 4 persons or flat rate of $250 for fewer than four people
blurb: Salt Devil Tritoon Cruises offers private, luxury cruises lasting 1.5 hours around historical Port Aransas. Guests can enjoy sightseeing including the Lydia Ann Lighthouse, birdwatching, and dolphin watching. The boat features luxury seating, a sun deck, a premium sound system, and onboard facilities including a port a potty and sink.
extraNote: BYOB, Snacks, Coolers, Ice Chests allowed · Port Aransas Municipal Boat Harbor, 301 JC Barr Blvd, Port Aransas, TX 78373
